column3: (they) will enjoy for hundreds of years, dear
you two did not enjoy the enjoyments
of the lord of Bhojas, this
of the lord of Bhojas, about to die
with Bhojas, Vrishnis, Andhakas, Madhus, Shurasenas, Dasharhas
in the house of the Bhoja king, like a flame
greatly with the restlessness of whirling balls
in the bees' singing rasa assembly
with shining excellent jewel on the neck
adorned with a thousand shining jewelled pillars
turned back from insistence on brother's command
by one tormented by the brother's slaying
by brothers stationed in the directions
pain in heart for brother and cousin
killer of the brother, senses' delight, violent
the brothers, lord of the three worlds
scratching with tips of the rocks of the whirling Mandara mountain, sleepy
of the whirling dull-minded, O Lord of great glory, your way of knowledge is unclear
with terrible tusks on the surface of the frown
brought to the middle of the brows, blameless
all guardians terrified by the brow's opening
to the knitting of the brows
showing great grace by a movement of the brows
in the movement of the brows
by a mere movement of brows
by the vine of the brow
full of auspicious cities, villages, cow-stations, mines
lovely cheeks shining with ear-pendants shaped like makara
pointing to the syllable M as the weapon
like flies, scaring and beating forest elephants
made of sacrifice, the Self of all gods
from the bond of action named Magadha
O Indra, of this enemy's great rise
worship of limbs and so on
of him whose neck is pierced by my spear
body pierced by my spear, untouched by fire
bath, ointment, silk garment, ornaments, garlands, scent, betel, nectar and wine and so on
ignorance of the Self not separate in the body
in the description of the Manvantara (garbled)
jewel earrings, garlands, turbans, jackets, silk, costly necklaces
I with the jewel, of this one
chief jewel ornaments, pebbles of gems
endowed with a hundred jewel pillars
the circle, Udaya mountain, sole hero protector
enticed in mind, ear in front
mind by the sound of streams in directions and intermediate directions
mind by the sound of streams in directions
delusion of mind, temptation of mind
mind (to) the feet of the Far-stepper, so long
marked with the rise of my stories
by my deeds, by my story
in the form of intoxicated, inert, deaf
resounding with groups of intoxicated birds
with the prowess of an intoxicated elephant
with the sweet note of intoxicated bees
with the garland of intoxicated bees
intoxicated bees' sweet sound, hair thrilled, creepers
pomp of dancing intoxicated peacocks, calling intoxicated cuckoos
you are intoxicated, son of Uttanapada, unsuspecting
from me also beyond the endless
devoted to me, faultless-bodied, like a flame of fire for the wise
water of my feet's holy places
devoted to service of my feet
by hearing and reciting my holy stories
rushed to fulfil my vow of truth
for attaining me: Brahma, Shiva, gods and demons
love for me, the view of the knower of truth
in the form of a fish
the water offering of my two friends
water with lotus pollen stirred by fish and tortoises
by incarnations: fish, tortoise, boar and others
by fishermen with nets, and others
by incarnations as fish and others, incarnating
narration of the fish incarnation's deeds
narration of the fish incarnation's deeds
fish, horse, tortoise, man-lion, boar, swan
the fish swallowed, from its belly here
Matsya, Ushinara, Kosala, Vidarbha, Kuru, Srinjaya
then the divine, the elemental, the other
Mathura and others, the essence by that
when the ocean was being churned
state with mind fixed on me
from desire to meditate on me
may the devoted to me protect
efforts of limbs for my sake
renouncing world and Veda for me
of own ones who gave up world and Veda for me
followed by bees blind with rut
karmic bond destroyed by great joy at seeing me
of my dharma, Uddhava, even slightly
delight of mind in my dharma
in striking down mountains by my hands
by sight, touch, worship, praise, salutation of my abode
of the haters of my devotees too
worship of my devotees is greater
devoid of devotion to me, the Self
eyes reddened with liquor and passion
refuge in strength of my yoga
of you pierced by my arrows
stories of the destroyer of Madhu
rivers' remnants of nectar of the stories of the destroyer of Madhu
sweet and other tastes, by him
resounding with voices of rows of bees
knower of meaning of honey, honey
in the middle of the mind
mind, prana, elements, senses, qualities and support
created by emission of mind, body, intellect
from conquest of mind, of men, from disease
from conquest of mind, greed, pretence, resort to heresy
in the mind, objects of senses
in the wave of the mind
